leadText:
Chaz (Japanese: エイジ Eiji) is a minor recurring character in . He made his main appearance in All Things Bright and Beautifly!.

Chaz is a Pokémon Coordinator who entered the Rustboro City Pokémon Contest alongside his friend and rival, Janet. In the end, he and Janet both made it to the final round. Chaz used his against her , but ended up losing to her.

Upon finding out 's intention to battle the Rustboro Gym with his , Chaz instructed Ash to teach Pikachu the move with the help of his in order to overcome Roxanne's .

Chaz also had a cameo in Deceit and Assist, watching compete in the Hoenn Grand Festival. He appears to know Timmy Grimm from Verdanturf Town, as he was seen watching the Grand Festival with him.
